faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Find quick answers to common questions about inquiries, product guidance, custom box specifications, and working with AAVRIT PACKAGING.

faqs.question: How can I request a packaging quotation?
faqs.answer: You can submit your requirements through our online inquiry form on this page, or reach out to our team directly via phone (+91 98765 43210) or email (inquiry@aavritpackaging.com) with your box dimensions, required ply construction, and estimated order volume.

faqs.question: What information should I provide for a custom packaging inquiry?
faqs.answer: Providing your internal box dimensions (Length × Width × Height in mm or inches), product gross weight, stacking or transit environment, flute/ply preference (3-Ply, 5-Ply, or 7-Ply), and any custom flexographic branding artwork ensures we can quote quickly and accurately.

faqs.question: Can I discuss bulk packaging requirements?
faqs.answer: Yes. We specialize in high-volume industrial corrugated packaging and enterprise B2B supply agreements. Our manufacturing plant operates multi-station flexo folder-gluers and rotary die-cutters optimized for rapid turnaround and recurring scheduled dispatches.

faqs.question: Can I share reference images or packaging specifications?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You can attach reference box photographs, technical CAD drawings, or structural specification sheets directly via the file upload field in our inquiry form, or email them to inquiry@aavritpackaging.com.

faqs.question: How can I contact the company for product-related questions?
faqs.answer: You can call our direct customer support desk at +91 98765 43210 during plant operating hours (Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM – 6:30 PM), send us an email, or visit our manufacturing facility in GIDC Industrial Estate, Gujarat.
